title: 第154章 出来了
slug: 穿越民国获得每日签到系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

凌晨三点半，城南“通和车行”。

卷帘门死死拉着，门缝底下透出一线昏黄的灯光。

“叩、叩、叩。”

敲门声在死寂的深夜里格外清晰。

门内，赵四海正缩在柜台后的破藤椅上打盹，脚边扔着半瓶劣质烧酒。

听到声音，他猛地睁开眼，抄起桌底下的撬棍，蹑手蹑脚走到门后。

“谁？”

“车行老板？开门，有笔大买卖找你。”门外传来一个沙哑的男声，带着浓重的喘息。

赵四海犹豫了一下，还是拉开了门闩。

卷帘门被推起一半，一个高大的男人硬生生挤了进来。

来人正是刘老板。他连大衣都没穿好，领带歪斜，头发被风吹得凌乱不堪。

平日里在商会里端着架子、不可一世的刘老板，此刻双眼布满血丝，像一头被逼到悬崖边的野兽。

“你找谁？”赵四海握着撬棍，警惕地打量着这个不速之客。

刘老板反手将卷帘门拉下，顺手插上门栓。

他转过身，目光扫过赵四海手里的撬棍，没有理会，而是径直走到柜台前。

“你是赵四海？”

“我是。你哪位？”

“姓刘。”刘老板从怀里掏出一个沉甸甸的牛皮纸袋，砸在柜台上。纸袋散开，露出一沓沓码得整整齐齐的大洋。

赵四海的目光瞬间被那些大洋吸住了，喉结滚动了一下。

“今晚有一趟活。”刘老板盯着他，声音压得极低，“去城外军需中转站，拉五千匹棉纱，连夜运到法租界的仓库。价钱是平时的五倍。”

赵四海咽了口唾沫，却没有伸手去拿钱。

“刘老板，这大半夜的，五千匹棉纱……”

他往后退了一步，“这活儿我接不了。现在外面都在传，日本人正愁没地方撒气，谁碰这批货谁就是通共。”

“你不接？”刘老板的眼神瞬间冷了下来。

“不接。”赵四海摇头，“钱再多，也得有命花。”

刘老板死死盯着他看了三秒，突然从腰间拔出一把勃朗宁手枪，冰冷的枪管直接顶在了赵四海的脑门上。

赵四海浑身一僵，连呼吸都停滞了。

“赵四海，我知道你欠了赌场的钱，明天一早他们就要来卸你的腿。”

刘老板的声音像是从牙缝里挤出来的，“你现在接了这趟活，拿上这笔钱，连夜离开上海。你要是不接——”

他的手指搭上了扳机。

“老子今晚就崩了你。反正明天我也活不成了，不如拉你一起垫背。”

汗水顺着赵四海的额头流进眼睛里，刺痛无比。

Page (1/3)

At 3:30 in the morning, there was a "Tonghe Car Dealer" in the south of the city.

The rolling shutter door was tightly closed, and a dim light came from under the crack.

"Knock, knock, knock."

The knocking on the door was particularly clear in the dead silence of the night.

Inside the door, Zhao Sihai was huddled on a broken wicker chair behind the counter and taking a nap, with half a bottle of low-quality soju thrown at his feet.

Hearing the sound, he opened his eyes suddenly, picked up the crowbar under the table, and tiptoed to the door.

"Who?"

"Boss of the car dealership? Open the door. I have a big deal for you." A hoarse male voice came from outside the door, with heavy breathing.

Zhao Sihai hesitated for a moment and then opened the door latch.

The rolling shutter door was pushed halfway, and a tall man squeezed in.

The person coming was none other than Boss Liu.He hadn't even put on his coat, his tie was askew, and his hair was messy in the wind.

Boss Liu, who usually puts on an air of arrogance in the chamber of commerce, now has bloodshot eyes, like a beast being pushed to the edge of a cliff.

"Who are you looking for?" Zhao Sihai held the crowbar and looked at the uninvited guest warily.

Boss Liu pulled down the rolling shutter door with his backhand and inserted the door bolt.

He turned around, glanced at the crowbar in Zhao Sihai's hand, ignored it, and walked straight to the counter.

"Are you Zhao Sihai?"

"I am. Who are you?"

"My surname is Liu." Boss Liu took out a heavy brown paper bag from his arms and threw it on the counter.The paper bag spread out, revealing a neatly stacked ocean.

Zhao Sihai's eyes were instantly attracted by those oceans, and his Adam's apple rolled.

"We have a job tonight." Boss Liu stared at him and spoke in a very low voice. "Go to the military supply transfer station outside the city to pull 5,000 pieces of cotton yarn and transport it to the warehouse in the French Concession overnight. The price is five times the usual price."

Zhao Sihai swallowed, but did not reach out to get the money.

"Boss Liu, five thousand pieces of cotton yarn in the middle of the night..."

He took a step back and said, "I can't take on this job. Now it's spreading outside that the Japanese are worried about having nowhere to vent their anger. Anyone who touches this batch of goods will be a communist."

"You won't answer?" Boss Liu's eyes instantly turned cold.

"No." Zhao Sihai shook his head, "No matter how much money you have, you have to spend it with your life."

Boss Liu stared at him for three seconds, then suddenly pulled out a Browning pistol from his waist, and pressed the cold barrel directly against Zhao Sihai's forehead.

Zhao Sihai's whole body froze, and even his breathing stopped.

"Zhao Sihai, I know you owe money to the casino, and they will come to remove your legs tomorrow morning."

Boss Liu's voice seemed to be squeezed out from between his teeth, "You take this job now, take this money, and leave Shanghai overnight. If you don't take it -"

His finger was on the trigger.

"I'm going to break you tonight. I won't survive tomorrow anyway, so I might as well drag you along to support me."

Sweat flowed down Zhao Sihai's forehead and into his eyes, which stung extremely.
